scope: Implement a cross-platform local agent/enrollment skeleton with explicit node identity, authenticated versioned capability envelopes, replay rejection, lifecycle state, and allowlisted host-control operations only; do not expose a remote listener before authenticated encrypted transport exists.
completion_condition: Enrollment identity/capability envelope/lifecycle code, bounded replay-safe verification tests, docs/ADR/validation and CI are committed.
next_step: Build an offline/local agent skeleton using explicit enrollment material and authenticated capability envelopes, with no arbitrary execution surface and no remote listener.
instructions: Use standard-library HMAC-SHA256 primitives rather than implementing cryptography. Secrets are injected at runtime and never serialized to repository/config/output. This slice does not claim secure LAN transport; mutual authenticated encryption remains the next gate.
